limitations: Two folders returned exactly 1000 entries; additional unseen entries cannot be excluded without an owner-provided complete manifest or a reliably paginated listing API.
Connector search returned fewer root children than direct list_folder; search was not used as exhaustive inventory evidence.
No absence claim is made for files outside returned listings, inaccessible artifacts or external governance records.

required_owner_actions: Restrict public link write access using the owner's approved secure channel; no sharing mutation was performed by this audit.
Provide written evaluation/data-use authorization, applicable image licenses and patient-consent or ethics documentation in an approved private location.
Provide a complete immutable image/hash manifest, modality and de-identified patient-group identifiers with train/validation/test provenance.
Provide independently clinician-reviewed annotations with class definitions, box/mask coordinate conventions, reviewer qualifications and disagreement resolution.
Re-audit source hashes and leakage after governance and access controls are verified, before any download or evaluation.
